description_sources.content: Reading Loom was a book reading journal service. Users stored book records and reading notes in their own AT Protocol PDS using the custom org.readingloom.book Lexicon. Official closure announcement: the hosted reading journal service permanently ended on 2026-08-31. The Lexicon definitions remain publicly available for developers. This announcement does not describe any replacement hosted service.
